{{Top|leg}}
The '''systems upgrade''' completely re-wrote a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] system software using complex mathematics and advanced binary languages. This upgrade stimulated the droid into being more efficient, powerful, and faster.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
